name: Experience Abstraction
desc:
Experience Abstraction in a Roblox game inspired by the hit web series The Amazing Digital Circus.

💡Ways to lose Sanity:
- Isolate yourself from other players
- Stay in the dark for a very long time
- Hang out around abstracted people

Can you resist abstraction, or will you lose yourself to it?


Credits to GLITCH for creating The Amazing Digital Circus.

llm.loop: explore circus-like rooms with other players -> keep your sanity up by staying with others and out of the dark -> avoid abstracted people -> survive without being abstracted
llm.objectives: resist abstraction by keeping your sanity
llm.instructions: sanity drops if you isolate yourself, stay in the dark too long or hang around abstracted people
unique: sanity drains when you are alone, so players are pushed to stay together
The Amazing Digital Circus abstraction concept
llm.thumbnails: dark rooms with glowing abstraction swirls and EXPERIENCE ABSTRACTION logo, close-up of TADC-style characters (bunny and gloved hands)
llm.complexity_notes: themed interior maps, lighting, sanity system and abstraction state; 43.6M visits, no paid perks
